acceptance_criteria.criterion: packages/core/src/index.mts exports branded TypeScript types Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, and Tick.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: index.mts publicly re-exports all five types from nominal-types.mjs; nominal-types.mts defines distinct bigint or number intersection brands.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: packages/core/src/index.mts exports QUANTITY_SCALE as 100_000_000n, PRICE_SCALE as 10_000n, and RATE_SCALE as 100_000_000n, with bigint literal types preserved where supported by existing conventions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: nominal-types.mts declares the three values as const bigint literals with the exact required values, and index.mts re-exports them. Runtime tests verify both bigint type and exact value.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Money, Quantity, Price, and Rate constructors reject non-bigint inputs and accept bigint inputs without precision conversion.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Each public asX constructor passes its input through assertBigint and returns the original bigint value. Tests cover zero, negative, very large bigint values, and representative non-bigint runtime inputs for all four constructors.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tick validation accepts 0 and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and rejects every specified invalid category.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: asTick checks number type, NaN, both infinities, integer status, and the inclusive 0..Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER range. Tests explicitly cover both boundaries, -1, MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1, fractional values, NaN, infinities, bigint, string, null, and undefined, plus additional invalid types.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Compile-time fixtures demonstrate primitive and cross-brand assignment rejection and constructor-produced value acceptance.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: __nominal_types_typecheck__.mts contains positive assignments from every constructor and @ts-expect-error assertions for direct bigint/number assignments and representative cross-brand assignments, including bigint brands versus Tick. The strict compile completed without diagnostics.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No packages/core import is introduced, and the repository boundary checker remains green.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The new core implementation has no imports, while the type fixture imports only local core modules. The reported standalone boundary command returned 'dependency-boundary: OK. 15 workspace packages validated against §14.5.'

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The full existing test suite, strict TypeScript build/typecheck, lint suite, determinism-lint fixtures, and boundary validation remain green.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Automated validation reports lint PASS and 166/166 tests passing with no skips; tests 149–166 include determinism-lint fixtures. The test lifecycle runs the compile pretest, and the implementer additionally reports standalone compile and boundary commands passing.

payload.summary: The candidate fully implements the requested nominal economic types, fixed scales, runtime validation, brand-isolation fixtures, and public exports while preserving core boundaries and deterministic behavior. Automated and reported repository validation is sufficient and green.
